judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving two of its own facets unchecked and committing `.lore/dod.md`. While the core `Ajv` validation and WeakMap caching in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` are largely functional, `register` erroneously compiles the initial schema of function-valued definitions at registration time rather than only per-call. Most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra properties pass-through, dynamic schema updates, static compilation count, unknown tool throw) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, having been partially placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead. Furthermore, the candidate completely missed the required documentation updates in `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, the JSDoc comment on `execute`, and the full changelog note.
